thread:
maria: Heads-up — Equinox Cloud asks us to greenlight their eu-south-2 edge region launch. They want committed quota for A100-80GB (20 GPUs) + fallback pool of g4dn equivalents. Target launch 2026-05-10. Need: marketplace SKU mapping, quota entitlement, KMS key approval, and a billing SKU for reserved capacity.

samir: Can you drop the partner SKU link + the exact quota numbers? I need to check compatibility with our Dedicated routing policies.

maria: Link: https://equinox.partner/marketplace/listings/eqw-edge-2026 (partner portal). Quotas: 20 A100-80GB, fallback 50 g4dn-8x. They also want a soft-reserve window for first 30 days.

kelly: FYI ops note — soft-reserve is fine but we need autoscale caps to prevent cross-customer bleed. We'll want a separate pool id and route by partner-tag.

ajay: Legal needs the marketplace contract clause for reserved capacity. Also KMS: partner is using their HSM; we need an attestation + our KMS allowlist entry. Tom, can Equinox provide the attestation doc?

tom (equinox): Yes — we'll upload attestation by EOD tomorrow. Also confirming they'll support our standard rollback SLA in the early phase.

samir: Technical checklist for infra: 1) validate model images on A100 path (fp16/4bit quant) 2) kernel compatibility tests 3) warm cache plan for first-week traffic. I can run the kernel checks if we get image tags.

maria: Image tags: eqw-edge-a100:v1.2.1 (verified by partner). There's also eqw-edge-g4dn:fallback-2026.

kelly: Ops action: create pool "equinox-eu-south-2" with labels partner:equinox, region:eu-south-2. I'll open a ticket in infra (INFRA-6241). Need confirmation of quotas from platform team to file marketplace entitlement.

maria: Approvals needed this week: platform quota signoff, finance billing SKU mapping, legal KMS attestation. If all green, we submit marketplace entitlement request by Wed to hit the May 10 launch.

ajay: I'll review attestation and draft a minimal contract addendum — aiming to have a legal OK by Thu.

samir: I started a compat run: `./tools/run-kernel-check --image eqw-edge-a100:v1.2.1 --hw A100-80GB` — current blockers: libcudnn mismatch on one node type, tracking in #eng-runtime.

kelly: Ops note: fallback policy should be: try A100 pool for 3s, then route to g4dn pool. Also add traffic shaping for first 72h. I'll add to INFRA-6241.

maria: Finance: need a billing SKU. Proposed mapping: RB_RESERVED_EQUINOX_EUS2_A100 -> monthly reserved, RB_OVERAGE_EQUINOX_EUS2_G4DN -> overage. @finance please confirm.

tom (equinox): Confirmed public launch comms will align with Redwood's timing. We'll hold press until entitlements and KMS greenlight.

deploy-bot: marketplace-entitlement: created ticket ME-8892 for Equinox eu-south-2 quota request.

maria: Summary / owners: samir -> infra compat + quota signoff, kelly -> pool creation + autoscale policy, ajay -> legal & KMS attestation, tom -> partner attestation upload, finance (cc) -> billing SKU confirmation. Goal: submit entitlement Wed, final go/no-go Fri EOD.

samir: I'll have kernel check results by Tue morning and file any infra blockers.

kelly: I'll start pool provisioning checklist tonight and link to INFRA-6241.

ajay: Noted. Awaiting attestation doc from Tom.

maria: Thanks all — ping here for any blocking items. :thumbsup:
